purpose: Keep AgentOS authority, conversations, controller state, campaign state, evidence, handoffs, and source-preservation records outside a user project by default.

storage_backends.LOCAL: Keep the AgentOS home on the local machine without requiring Git.
storage_backends.GIT: Keep the AgentOS home as its own Git repository.
storage_backends.HYBRID: Keep durable AgentOS material in its own Git repository and retain explicitly local-only working material outside the release-facing subset.

modes.EXTERNAL_DEFAULT: Use a separate sibling control folder derived from the project folder.
modes.EXTERNAL_EXPLICIT: Use a separate owner-selected folder outside the project folder.
modes.IN_PROJECT_OPT_IN: Allow the control folder inside the project only when the owner explicitly selects that mode.

default_rule: The product folder is source and delivery space. The control plane is separate state and authority space. Bootstrap must not create AgentOS control artifacts in the product folder unless IN_PROJECT_OPT_IN is explicitly bound.
boundary_rule: External control planes may not overlap the project root. In-project control planes must be contained by the project root and must carry the explicit opt-in mode.
binding_rule: The project root, control-plane root, mode, storage scope, artifact groups, and source-preservation rule are content-addressed together and rechecked before writes.
public_repo_rule: Public distribution contains reusable AgentOS code, contracts, documentation, tests, and synthetic examples only. Runtime control-plane records, owner conversations, private handoffs, credentials, and external paths are never copied into it.
